meta.prompt: Plan two days in Kyoto as an inline itinerary: a timeline per day with times, places, how to get between them and how long it takes. Each stop expands for details, each day has a checklist of things to book that I can tick off, and a line at the top says how many are left.
meta.text:
The error is about ExpansionTile: the title has to be written as `text` with a label, and the spelling must match the type name exactly. I'll keep the same structure, use the correct type name, and fix the checklist counter so it uses the variables properly.

Card gap:12 pad:16 w:390
  Text.title "Kyoto: two days"
  state booked=0
  state todo1=false
  state todo2=false
  state todo3=false
  state todo4=false
  state todo5=false
  Text.muted "Things to book left: {5-booked}"
  Text.heading "Day 1: Higashiyama"
  Column gap:8
    ExpansionTile "08:30  Fushimi Inari Taisha"
      Text.body "Walk through the torii gates up Mount Inari, about 2 hours round trip. Arrive early to avoid crowds."
      Text.small "Getting there: JR Nara Line to Inari Station, 5 min walk from Kyoto Station (about 5 min)."
    ExpansionTile "11:00  Kiyomizu-dera"
      Text.body "Hillside temple with a wooden stage over the valley. Allow 90 minutes."
      Text.small "Getting there: bus 206 from Inari area to Kiyomizu-michi, then 10 min uphill walk (about 35 min)."
    ExpansionTile "13:30  Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka"
      Text.body "Preserved stone lanes lined with teahouses and craft shops, leading down from Kiyomizu."
      Text.small "Getting there: 10 min downhill walk from Kiyomizu-dera (about 10 min)."
    ExpansionTile "16:00  Gion district"
      Text.body "Traditional wooden machiya streets. Best in the early evening for a chance to glimpse geiko and maiko."
      Text.small "Getting there: 15 min walk along Shirakawa canal (about 15 min)."
  Text.strong "Day 1 checklist"
  Column gap:6
    Checkbox "Book Kiyomizu-dera evening illumination (seasonal)" =todo1 -> booked=booked+(todo1?1:-1)
    Checkbox "Reserve a kaiseki dinner in Gion" =todo2 -> booked=booked+(todo2?1:-1)
  Text.heading "Day 2: Arashiyama and north"
  Column gap:8
    ExpansionTile "08:00  Arashiyama Bamboo Grove"
      Text.body "Walk the towering bamboo path early before tour groups arrive. Allow 45 minutes."
      Text.small "Getting there: JR Sagano Line from Kyoto Station to Saga-Arashiyama (about 15 min)."
    ExpansionTile "09:30  Tenryu-ji"
      Text.body "UNESCO temple with a famous garden of borrowed scenery. Allow 60 minutes."
      Text.small "Getting there: 5 min walk from the bamboo grove (about 5 min)."
    ExpansionTile "11:30  Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion)"
      Text.body "Gold-leafed pavilion reflected in a pond. Allow 60 minutes."
      Text.small "Getting there: bus 205 or 101 from Arashiyama, about 30 min."
    ExpansionTile "14:00  Nishiki Market"
      Text.body "Narrow covered market for street food and local snacks. Allow 90 minutes."
      Text.small "Getting there: bus 205 to Shijo Karasuma, then 5 min walk (about 35 min)."
  Text.strong "Day 2 checklist"
  Column gap:6
    Checkbox "Book Kinkaku-ji entry time slot" =todo3 -> booked=booked+(todo3?1:-1)
    Checkbox "Reserve Arashiyama train tickets (IC card works)" =todo4 -> booked=booked+(todo4?1:-1)
    Checkbox "Book Tenryu-ji garden entry" =todo5 -> booked=booked+(todo5?1:-1)
